Class MutexOrchestrator

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.mutex.orchestrator.MutexOrchestrator
public class MutexOrchestrator extends Object
Implementing MutexActor lock by composing the NfsMutexActor, and FileChannelActor which collectively offer a Mutex which can be acquired and released.
Currently the algorithm only runs as a waiter/holds the executing thread.
